item.title: Gunsmoke - The Brothers
item.description: Matt captures a young outlaw, who waits for his brother to free him.

item.title: The Waltons - The Triangle
item.description: John Boy's growing attachment to Miss Hunter is rocked when she becomes interested in someone else.

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - Blind Tiger
item.description: McGarrett gets more than he bargained for when a birthday present explodes and blinds him. As the Five-O team searches for the would-be assassin, McGarrett tries to recuperate with the help of the tough Nurse Edith Lavallo (played by Marion Ross of 'Happy Days').

item.title: Matlock - Don, The (Part 1)
item.description: Matlock represents Nicholas Baron, a well-known mobster who has been accused of murdering a rival.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Absent Artist
item.description: Cartoonist Pete Manders is elated when the owner of the comic strip "Zingy" offers to sell him the strip for a song. However, Pete then learns that his girlfriend is running away to Europe with the strip's owner.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Wally's Car Accident
item.description: June and Ward go away for the weekend and Wally asks to borrow Ward's new car to go to a dance. Although hesitant, Ward finally gives in and lets him take it. However, after the dance, Lumpy runs into some car trouble which results in Wally smashing the headlight on the car. Wally is now faced with having it repaired and paying for it himself and trying to find a way to break it gently to Ward.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Beaver, the Sheep Dog
item.description: At school, Beaver gets into an argument with a girl who retaliates by making fun of Beaver's hair, calling him a sheepdog. Incredibly self-concious, Beaver goes out to the store and buys different hairsprays and gels to try to improve his hairdo. He doesn't get the reaction he was expecting when he tries his new hairdo out on his family.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Throwback Thursday: 1990
Adam-12 - Log 56: Vice Versa
item.description: Because Malloy has allowed his driver's license to expire, Reed has to do the driving on today's busy patrol. They search for an ice cream truck driver who's been trying to sell marijuana to children, get an unexpected reaction from a bank robber, help a man who's had his house completely emptied by his neighbors, deal with a woman who shoots her husband dead and find a live baby in a trashcan.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 16: Child in Danger
item.description: Malloy and Reed are called to a tavern robbery in progress, and then are jolted by a severe domestic abuse situation they are powerless to stop. In the meantime, they lose track of a naive college girl who has just been carjacked by a convicted rapist.
